//: Character creation: the screen of the role `creation`, reached from the new-game screen with F2. It edits the creation session the application keeps (06 §10.3), which it reads as `app.creation` and changes through the `app` service `creation`. Everything it shows comes from the templates' data: the choices of every kind, their options, parts, bounds and budgets, what is chosen and whether the character is complete. With no session in progress it lists `app.templates` to begin one from. A choice is changed in the popup `create_choice`, which shows the widget that fits its kind. Begin finishes the character and asks for the game, at the start the screen was opened for (`scenario`).
title: Make a character

list.empty: The loaded mods offer nothing to make a character from.
list.tip: Enter begins a character of this kind.

number.label: Seed
number.tip: What any choice left to chance is drawn from.

rows.text: <dim>Made from</> {if screen.made_from != '' then screen.made_from else str(app.creation.templates[0] ?? '')}

list.item: {if it.depth > 0 then '  ' else ''}{it.name}  <dim>{if it.kind == 'text' then (if (it.value ?? '') == '' then 'none yet' else it.value) else if it.kind == 'range' then str(it.value) else if it.kind == 'pick' then (if len(it.value) == 1 then first(it.value) else str(len(it.value)) + ' of ' + str(it.count)) else if it.kind == 'points' then str(it.spent) + ' of ' + str(it.budget) + ' spent' else str(len(it.value)) + ' of ' + str(it.budget) + ' parts'}</>

button.label: Begin
button.tip: Make the character and begin the game.

button.label: Start over
button.tip: Begin again from a kind of your choosing.

tooltip.value: Tab moves, Enter changes or takes, Esc goes back.

//: One choice of the creation session, opened from the creation screen with its number in `app.creation.choices` and, for a number or a text, the value to start from. It shows the widget that fits the choice's kind: the options of a `pick` or `points` choice, each taken or put back with Enter (a pick of one puts the new one in place of the old); the parts an `assemble` choice allows, Enter adding one and Backspace taking them back; a number for a `range`, within its bounds; a line for a `text`. Enter takes a number or a text; Esc closes.
title: Choose

rows.text: <dim>{if app.creation.choices[$index].kind == 'pick' then 'Pick ' + str(app.creation.choices[$index].count) + '.' else if app.creation.choices[$index].kind == 'points' then str(app.creation.choices[$index].left) + ' of ' + str(app.creation.choices[$index].budget) + ' points left.' else if app.creation.choices[$index].kind == 'assemble' then str(len(app.creation.choices[$index].value)) + ' of ' + str(app.creation.choices[$index].budget) + ' parts.' else if app.creation.choices[$index].kind == 'range' then 'From ' + str(app.creation.choices[$index].min) + ' to ' + str(app.creation.choices[$index].max) + '.' else 'At most ' + str(app.creation.choices[$index].max_length) + ' letters.'}</>

list.item: {if it.chosen then '[x]' else '[ ]'} {it.name}{if app.creation.choices[$index].kind == 'points' then '  (' + str(it.cost) + ')' else ''}

creation.value: if app.creation.choices[$index].kind == 'points' then (if it.chosen then without(app.creation.choices[$index].value, it.id) else app.creation.choices[$index].value + [it.id]) else if it.chosen then app.creation.choices[$index].value else if len(app.creation.choices[$index].value) < app.creation.choices[$index].count then app.creation.choices[$index].value + [it.id] else without(app.creation.choices[$index].value, first(app.creation.choices[$index].value)) + [it.id]

rows.text: <dim>{if app.creation.choices[$index].kind == 'assemble' then 'Enter adds one, Backspace takes them back, Esc closes.' else if app.creation.choices[$index].kind == 'range' or app.creation.choices[$index].kind == 'text' then 'Enter takes it, Esc leaves it as it was.' else 'Enter takes or puts back, Esc closes.'}</>

creation.value: if app.creation.choices[$index].kind == 'range' then screen.amount else if app.creation.choices[$index].kind == 'text' then screen.words else app.creation.choices[$index].value
